name: What is the difference between repairing and replacing a wood fence panel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between repairing and replacing a wood fence panel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a wood fence panel involves fixing specific damaged sections, such as replacing a few pickets or a rail, to restore its functionality and appearance. Replacing a wood fence panel means removing the entire section and installing a new one. Repair is suitable for localized damage, while replacement is often necessary for widespread rot, structural failure, or significant aesthetic issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing fixes specific damaged sections; replacing means installing a new entire panel. Repair is for localized damage, replacement for widespread issues.
